findings.claim: The LANGUAGE stage recorded verdict CORRECTED but did not apply — or record any disposition of — the one G-ENG finding on file for this unit; the single edit it actually made was to a different, unflagged span.
findings.evidence: verdicts/verdicts-geng-2.jsonl and report.json both carry: severity 'minor', quote 'leaving too little coming off the floor to show the rain', note "class 3 (option text, q1 D): the head noun is elided, so 'too little' is left without its referent ... Editor's rewrite: 'leaving too little light coming off the floor to show the rain'." The shipped candidates-final/elf-b11-003.json option D still reads verbatim: 'Because the foam in the tray takes in light as well as sound, leaving too little coming off the floor to show the rain.' The only candidates -> candidates-corrected diff is in the passage: 'A pipe drilled with the right nozzles' -> 'A pipe fitted with the right nozzles'. reviews/language.jsonl contains only {"verdict":"CORRECTED"} with no findings array.
findings.why: Per BATCH-RUNBOOK stage 6 the language reviewer 'adjudicates AND applies edits', so an open G-ENG flag is its to dispose of. The overrule may well be correct on the merits — 'too little' with an elided head noun is legal English and 'light' is recoverable from 'takes in light as well as sound' two clauses earlier — and the flag was a 1-of-3 minority minor, so this does not invalidate CORRECTED. It is a traceability gap, not a text defect: the record cannot distinguish 'considered and overruled' from 'not seen'. The unit ships as SURVIVED_FLAGGED, so the flag does still reach owner adjudication.

findings.claim: The passage's stated optical mechanism does not actually entail its own conclusion: a drop that 'shows only by the light it throws back' is precisely a drop that would throw a front beam back at the audience. No stage recorded this, and the rationale reproduces the gap as settled physics.
findings.evidence: Passage sentence 4: 'A falling drop shows only by the light it throws back, and a beam from the front of the house passes straight through the shower and lands on the scenery, which obligingly lights up instead.' The rationale asserts in its own voice: 'C paraphrases both halves - visibility depends on returned light, and a front beam does not return, it continues to the set.' Retroreflection by water droplets is the standard reason rain is conspicuous in head-on car headlights, so 'throws back' and 'passes straight through' cannot both hold generally; the passage's real contrast argument is carried by 'which obligingly lights up instead' and by 'a bright point against a dark ground', not by the through-transmission claim.
findings.why: Pedagogy's remit includes fact-checking the teaching payload, and this is a simplification a physics-literate student can contest. It is minor rather than verdict-changing because (a) the stem is scoped 'According to the text', (b) the rationale is reporting the passage rather than asserting independent physics, and (c) the labelled trap on A ('plausible-but-wrong physics') is itself correct — water is near-transparent in the visible, so A's 'absorbed rather than thrown back' is genuinely false. MINOR_FIXES stands.

confirmations.language: No missed calque, agreement, register or spelling-variety defect found. BrE is held throughout student-facing text ('theatre', 'litres'); zero AmE tokens in passage or options. Theatre idiom is correct and native ('the boards', 'the front of the house', 'a bright point against a dark ground', 'bury the dialogue'). Subject-verb agreement clean across all coordinate clauses ('A pipe ... will hang', 'a tray ... will carry', 'bare metal ... drums'). The CORRECTED verdict is earned: 'A pipe drilled with the right nozzles' was a real collocation error (nozzles are fitted to a pipe, not drilled) and was fixed.
confirmations.pedagogy: Every factual claim in the rationale checks out against the shipped text: A does reverse the stated behaviour ('absorbed rather than thrown back' vs 'passes straight through the shower'); 'read as a shadow' is a mechanism the passage never proposes; the passage attributes nothing to shadows, so B is genuine outside_knowledge; the foam is introduced as 'a separate problem' about drumming noise and no claim is made about light off the floor, so D is genuine surface_word_match. Trap labels name the actual traps. Hedge-balance claim verified programmatically: zero hedge markers in any option, and the key is NOT the longest (B is longest at 136 chars / 25 words; C is 116 chars / 23 words).
confirmations.integrated: All five quoted spans in the rationale appear VERBATIM in current passage or option text. No self-contradiction. No cross-question leak (single-question unit) and no topical overlap with elf-b11-001/002/004. The MINOR_NOTES verdict is earned: the corrected -> final diff fixes a real integrated defect, 'the two-sentence mechanism' -> 'the two-clause mechanism sentence', and the amended description is accurate — sentence 4 is one sentence with two coordinate main clauses. generator_meta reconciles with the text: spelling_note's named markers 'theatre' and 'litres' both present, fictional_entities complete, hedge_balance_note accurate.
confirmations.key_sanity: C is the single defensible best answer and would survive a complaining student. C paraphrases both halves of the passage's own causal premise ('shows only by the light it returns' <- 'shows only by the light it throws back'; 'carries on through the shower to the set behind' <- 'passes straight through the shower and lands on the scenery'). A is directly contradicted by 'passes straight through'. B introduces actors and shadows, neither of which appears anywhere in the passage. D contradicts 'a separate problem' and invents a light-absorption property for the foam. Both G-KEY solver votes independently returned C.
confirmations.gate_flag_disposition: The open G-STEM major (WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick C) is NOT a defect the reviews failed to catch. gates/prompts/G-STEM.md states the calibrated contract explicitly: 'WORLD_KNOWLEDGE or PARTIALLY -> flag (severity major) - survives to adjudication', and 'Authentic HP items very often have globally-true keys ... That is normal test design, not a defect.' The flag correctly routes to owner adjudication at runbook stage 11/12; it is not language's or pedagogy's to clear.
